reports.title: Elanco Animal Health Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: •Full Year 2026 Guidance
section: ◦Raising revenue guidance to $5.155 billion to $5.18 billion, or approximately 8% organic constant currency growth
◦Raising Adjusted EBITDA guidance to $1.05 billion to $1.065 billion, a year-over-year increase of 17% at midpoint
◦Raising Adjusted EPS guidance to $1.17 to $1.20, a year-over-year increase of 26% at midpoint
◦Improving year-end net leverage ratio target to approximately 2.9x Adjusted EBITDA with accelerated capital allocation flexibility

desk.headline: Revenue up 11% to $1.27bn and adj. EPS $0.27, both beat; 2026 outlook raised above estimates
results: Organic constant-currency growth was 9%, with price up 4% and volume up 5%.
Pet Health rose 14% to $608m on Zenrelia, Credelio Quattro and AdTab; in Farm Animal, cattle grew 17% while poultry fell 7%.
Adjusted gross margin widened 300bp to 56.1% and adjusted EBITDA rose 23% to $243m (19.5% margin).
Swung to GAAP net income of $18m ($0.04 a share) from a $34m loss a year ago.
Net leverage fell to 2.9x adjusted EBITDA, a milestone reached earlier than planned.

guidance.summary: Full-year 2026 revenue, adjusted EBITDA and adjusted EPS ranges were all raised from August, and the innovation revenue target lifted to $1.275bn. Q4 guidance implies slower 4–6% organic growth; 2027 is expected to follow the long-term plan of mid-single-digit sales growth and low-double-digit EPS growth.

points: Zenrelia had its best quarter yet and Credelio Quattro became the largest US Pet Health brand, overtaking Seresto.
Price gains are expected to ease back toward the historical 2–3% range as launch offers are lapped.
Competition is heating up in dermatology and parasite control, with a new JAK rival and a competing IL-31 product; US dermatology revenue was flat.
Q4 growth slows to 4–6% organic while operating costs rise about 11%; losing the Costco account will mainly hit Q1 2027.
Befrena moves to full US launch and Credelio Quattro is due in the EU in Q1 2027; free cash flow of $362m so far this year.
